titulo.estudio: Il trasporto pubblico dopo la pandemia
titulo.alumno: B2 news report: public transport and mobility

intro: Analyse how demand for collective mobility has evolved since the health emergency, and distinguish investment in sustainable fleets from loyalty fare measures.

palabras.consejo: A feminine adjective for fares with a social discount.
A chemical element used as a clean fuel.

texto: All'indomani della crisi pandemica, gli abbonamenti al trasporto pubblico locale sono tornati a crescere nelle principali città italiane, pur senza raggiungere ovunque i livelli record registrati nel 2019. Per incentivare il ritorno a bordo di autobus, tram e metropolitane, molte amministrazioni comunali hanno introdotto tariffe agevolate per giovani e lavoratori a basso reddito, sostenute da fondi statali straordinari per la transizione ecologica. Al contempo, le aziende di mobilità urbana hanno accelerato il rinnovo dei parchi veicolari, sostituendo i vecchi mezzi diesel con vetture a trazione completamente elettrica o a idrogeno, dotate di sistemi avanzati di climatizzazione e sanificazione continua dell'aria. L'indagine delle associazioni di utenti evidenzia tuttavia che la puntualità delle corse e la frequenza nei fine settimana restano i fattori determinanti su cui si gioca la vera attrattività del servizio pubblico rispetto all'automobile privata.

frases.estudio: Gli abbonamenti ai mezzi pubblici sono tornati a crescere dopo la crisi sanitaria.
frases.alumno: Public transport season tickets have started to grow again after the health crisis.

frases.estudio: I comuni hanno introdotto tariffe agevolate per sostenere i cittadini a basso reddito.
frases.alumno: Councils have introduced reduced fares to support low-income citizens.

frases.estudio: Le aziende di trasporto hanno acquistato nuovi autobus elettrici a basso impatto ambientale.
frases.alumno: Transport companies have bought new electric buses with low environmental impact.

frases.estudio: La puntualità e la frequenza delle corse restano fondamentali per attirare i passeggeri.
frases.alumno: Punctuality and frequency of services remain essential to attract passengers.

pregunta.texto: What economic incentive did many councils introduce to encourage the use of collective transport?

opciones.texto: Reduced fares with social discounts for students and low-income workers
opciones.explicacion: A measure to encourage use, backed by ecological transition funds.

opciones.texto: Doubling the price of single tickets to fund free car parks
opciones.explicacion: It would discourage transport use rather than promote it.

opciones.texto: Free travel exclusively for those who travel with three pets
opciones.explicacion: An extravagant invention with no basis in mobility policy.

frase.texto: Molte aziende hanno acquistato autobus a trazione completamente ___ per ridurre le emissioni.

opciones.explicacion: An adjective agreeing with «trazione» that defines the decarbonisation of the fleet.
A polluting fossil fuel that is precisely being phased out.
A generic term that does not specify the zero-emission technology.

pregunta.texto: What cutting-edge technologies do the new vehicles in the urban fleet incorporate?

opciones.texto: Electric or hydrogen traction together with advanced air purification and climate control systems
opciones.explicacion: Substantial improvements in comfort and sustainability.

opciones.texto: Coal engines with external chimneys emitting visible steam
opciones.explicacion: An outdated nineteenth-century technology opposed to current environmentalism.

opciones.texto: Solid wooden seats with no ventilation or interior lighting whatsoever
opciones.explicacion: It contradicts modern standards of comfort and accessibility.

pregunta.texto: According to user associations, on what key elements does real competitiveness against the private car depend?

opciones.texto: On the strict punctuality of the service and an adequate frequency of departures at weekends
opciones.explicacion: Decisive factors in choosing public transport.

opciones.texto: On the installation of giant cinema screens inside every carriage
opciones.explicacion: A superfluous element unrelated to the reliability of the transport service.

opciones.texto: On drivers singing popular songs during night-time journeys
opciones.explicacion: A comic notion that does not meet service quality criteria.

frase.texto: Il trasporto pubblico rinnova la flotta

piezas.explicacion: Put the terms of the mobility news item in order.

pregunta.texto: How has the overall number of public transport users evolved since the pandemic?

opciones.texto: It has experienced a steady and sustained recovery, though it has not yet surpassed the historic highs of 2019.
opciones.explicacion: Sustained growth with room for improvement.

opciones.texto: It fell to zero users when people decided to travel exclusively on foot.
opciones.explicacion: An absurd claim that denies the reality of metropolitan traffic.

opciones.texto: It multiplied tenfold, saturating all stations from five in the morning.
opciones.explicacion: An improbable hyperbolic figure not recorded in the statistics.
